pageTitle: HomeTidy – iPhone Home Screen Tidy-up Planner
title: iPhone Home Screen Tidy-up Planner
lead: Pick screenshots of your Home Screen. HomeTidy reads the app names and makes a folder plan and step-by-step moves. Free, no sign-up.
privacyPill: Images are processed on this device only and never sent anywhere
s1hint: Take a screenshot of each Home Screen page (side button + volume up) and pick them all, in page order. Widget-only pages are not needed.
pasteHint: Open a screenshot in Photos, tap the Live Text button, then Copy All, and paste here. Apps are sorted by name only (no icons). Together with screenshots, it fills in apps that could not be read.
s2hint: Check that the green boxes sit on the icons. If not, use “Adjust by hand” below. Tap a box to switch it between app and not an app.
adjustTitle: Boxes are off? Adjust by hand
appliedAll: The same positions are now used for all screenshots.
slDockOn: Dock (4 icons at the bottom, no names)
cantOpen: Could not open {name}. Please save it as PNG or JPEG.
ocrLoading: Preparing text reading (about 9 MB the first time)
ocrFail: Text reading is not available. Type names by hand or use the paste box.
unknownHint: Tap a category, or type the name and tap OK. If unsure, choose Other.
restOther: Put all the rest in Other
starHint: Star the apps you use most. They go on page 1 (up to 20 on page 1 + 4 in the Dock).
pickCat: Not in the dictionary. Please tap a category.
optLibrary: Send apps without ★ to the App Library instead of folders
savePngHint: On iPhone you can also touch and hold the image below and choose Save to Photos.
pngFoot: Made with HomeTidy. Images were processed on this device only.
planUnresolved: {n} apps are still unknown and are not in the plan. Pick a category in step 3 to include them.
pNoStar: No starred apps yet. Star the apps you use most in step 3.
pDockNote: The 4 apps for the Dock (bottom row)
pLibraryNote: Removing an app from the Home Screen does not delete it. You can always open it from the App Library, to the right of your last page.
pOrder: Step by step, in screen order
pOrderNote: Starting from the top left of your current Home Screen, where each app goes.
noReadDock: Dock apps have no name on screen. Type the name or pick a category
toLibrary: to the App Library (Remove from Home Screen)
stEdit: Touch and hold an empty area of the Home Screen until the apps begin to jiggle. On some iOS versions, tap Edit at the top left, then Edit Apps.
stDock: Make the Dock contain {list}. Drag other apps out of the Dock.
stPage1: Place {list} on page 1, from the top left (drag an app to the edge of the screen and wait to move to the next page).
stFolder: Drag “{a}” onto “{b}” and wait: a folder is created. Name it “{name}”.
stLibrary: For {list}: touch and hold the app, tap Remove App, then Remove from Home Screen.
stPages: To hide pages that are now empty: in edit mode tap the dots at the bottom of the screen and uncheck those pages.
stDone: Tap Done at the top right.
focusIntro: Show only your work page during work, and only your fun page on weekends. Splitting pages with this plan first makes it easy.
focusSteps:
Go to the Settings app, tap Focus, then tap a Focus (for example Work or Personal).
Tap the Home Screen preview below Customize Screens.
Select the pages to show during this Focus, then tap Done.
When the Focus is on, only those pages are shown. You can change this any time in Settings > Focus.
focusNote: Wording differs slightly between iOS versions. The current Apple guide says: “Choose a customized Lock Screen or Home Screen page to switch to while the Focus is on.” Steps 2–3 are from the iOS 16 version of the guide.
focusUrlTitle: Set up a Focus on iPhone - Apple Support
checked: Checked on October 18, 2026 (current and iOS 16 versions)
dockHint: Apps in the Dock show no name, so they cannot be read. Pick a category, type the name and tap OK, or choose “Keep in Dock”.
keepAllDock: Keep the whole Dock as is
dupTitle: The same app is in more than one place
dupNotice: “{name}” is in {n} places ({where}). You can remove one of them (the app itself stays).
dupShort: Apps in two or more places (you can remove the extra one): {list}
stDup: {list} appear twice. Touch and hold the extra one, tap Remove App, then Remove from Home Screen (the app itself stays).
privacyList:
Screenshots are processed only inside this page (your browser). Nothing is sent to a server; there is no server.
Text reading (Tesseract.js) also runs on your device, using files hosted on this site.
The page’s Content-Security-Policy blocks sending data to any other site. The only exception is loading ad images, which never include your screenshots.
Screenshots and results are not stored. They are gone when you close the page. Only your language choice and the day the ad window was shown are kept in this browser.
No analytics and no cookies.
